judgement_calls.basis: Design section 23.2, "and `last`, and both are" now FIXES the scoping rule that V15-D02 recorded as missing: equity_curve.first and .last are window-scoped realized equity, first taken after every earlier cash event but before any cash event at the inclusive start timestamp. The design labels window scope an explicit AMENDMENT-CHOICE (Design section 23.2, "and `last`, and both are"), not a forced identity. Re-derived under that rule this revision; the value is unchanged. V15-D02 is CLOSED.
